name: ai-edit-video
description: AI Edit Video by noti.vn — Hybrid Architecture: Laravel API + Node.js Worker + Next.js Dashboard

scripts.dev: concurrently -n laravel,worker,web,horizon,reverb -c yellow,magenta,cyan,blue,green "npm run dev:laravel" "npm run dev -w apps/node-worker" "npm run dev -w apps/web" "npm run dev:horizon" "npm run dev:reverb"
scripts.dev:legacy: concurrently -n server,web -c yellow,cyan "npm run dev -w apps/server" "npm run dev -w apps/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w apps/node-worker && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.start: concurrently -n laravel,worker,web -c yellow,magenta,cyan "npm run dev:laravel" "npm run start -w apps/node-worker" "npm run start -w apps/web"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w apps/node-worker && npm run typecheck -w apps/web && npm run typecheck -w engines/remotion
